reason: I use Bitrix24 free or cheap and it works, even if it is heavy. $89 a month is a lot of money for me, and I would also have to move all my clients by hand.
objection: I pay about $15 per user elsewhere and cannot see why a flat $89 is better. With 7 to 15 people I would likely need the $199 Business plan anyway, and there is no help moving my data.
would_change_my_mind: A lower starting price (around $35 to $40) or free migration from Bitrix24 done for me, plus proof from another Uzbek company like mine.
